frequency_question: How often does a central bank successfully complete the administrative and technical rollout of an incremental reserve requirement instrument within a standard operating window of under five months from policy conception?
membership_rule: Includes any formal regulatory notification by a major central bank mandating banks to maintain a supplementary reserve ratio on incremental deposits. Excludes standard annual policy reviews that do not introduce new ratios.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named instances of rapid regulatory liquidity instruments; full universe of similar emerging market rapid reserve adjustments is estimated around 12 instances.
known_gaps: Focuses primarily on major jurisdictions with digital clearing infrastructure; smaller emerging markets with legacy manual reporting systems might exhibit longer technical friction.
skeleton: Central bank monetary policy committees meet on scheduled cycles; when liquidity conditions demand absorption, operational directives are drafted, vetted internally, and deployed within a 30 to 90-day implementation runway.
validity_reason: Central bank digital reporting and automated reserve maintenance systems remain stable across medium-term regulatory frameworks.
